# Growth Roadmap

Growth plans track intended learning. A planned, active, or completed task is never current capability evidence and never changes a role match state.

- [Acme platform gaps](acme-platform-gaps.md)

## Handoff boundary

A handoff is created only on explicit request and includes only confirmed, worthwhile gaps. It excludes `待确认` items and low-value Preferred gaps. This fixture intentionally contains no `roadmap-handoff.json`.

After work is completed, an actual reviewable artifact must be verified and recorded in the correct `personal-data/` owning file. Only a later explicit `refresh-match` may reassess `evidence-mapping.md`; the roadmap itself never edits it.
